runner.change: Inlines the accepted Node SSH reader, retains the first SSH snapshot and compares it at every recheck; the raw spawn path and receipt keys are unchanged.
runner.auditFindings: No blocker or high. One medium recorded as a limit: SSH drift after capture reports TRUST_DRIFT with an unresolved diagnostic binding instead of the earlier post-pin label; the verdict stays STOP.

launcher.change: Embeds the accepted PowerShell helper, checks the executing launcher path, refuses a pre-existing helper type, compiles once after closure and GO/time gates, and compares the two preflight SSH snapshots before the claim.
launcher.auditFindings: No blocker or high from the Opus auditor or the Fable reviewer. Recorded limits: run only in a fresh PowerShell 7 process without a profile and with the exact canonical launcher path; a refusal does not say which check failed.

limitations: Point checks on NTFS with PowerShell 7.6.5 and Node 24.19.0 only
Inert SSH fixtures only; the installed SSH binary was not read
Shared two-link profile tested only through copies that change the fixed hash and size
No real transport, process start, controller body after the claim, race immunity or image-at-spawn attestation
Not yet packaged; materializer, finalizer and adapter still use the earlier package
